{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
# The value 999 is likely a sentinel for missing data
# Let's check how many rows have biomarker_baseline == 999
n_sentinel_biomarker = (trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] == 999).sum()

# Check if this is the only sentinel value
# Also check for other common sentinel values in other columns
sentinel_values = [999, -999, 9999, -9999, 'NA', 'N/A', 'null', 'NULL', '']

# Check all columns for sentinel values
sentinel_counts = {}
for col in trial_df.columns:
    if trial_df[col].dtype == 'object':
        sentinel_counts[col] = trial_df[col].isin(sentinel_values).sum()
    else:
        sentinel_counts[col] = trial_df[col].isin(sentinel_values).sum()

# Filter only columns with non-zero sentinel counts
sentinel_counts = {k: v for k, v in sentinel_counts.items() if v > 0}

# Final count of patients
n_patients = len(trial_df)

# Report
print(f'Number of patients: {n_patients}')
print(f'Sentinel values found: {sentinel_counts}')"}
